pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Keka" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Documents/Important\ Documents.tar && rm -rf ~/Documents/Important\ Documents && mkdir -p ~/Documents/Important\ Documents && echo "hello" > ~/Documents/Important\ Documents/hello.txt
instruction: Create a TAR archive from the 'Important Documents' folder in Documents without compression and save it to Documents.
